doctors.bio_ms: Menyelia setiap pesakit dialisis dan memastikan pesakit mendapat dialisis yang optima. Menjalankan sesi lawatan secara berkala di pusat dialisis.
doctors.bio_en: Supervises every dialysis patient and ensures each receives optimal dialysis. Conducts periodic visits to the dialysis centre.

doctors.bio_ms: Melaksanakan penilaian mingguan pesakit sebelum dan selepas sesi dialisis, termasuk pemantauan tekanan darah serta membuat rujukan segera kepada pihak berkaitan apabila diperlukan.
doctors.bio_en: Carries out weekly patient assessments before and after dialysis sessions, including blood-pressure monitoring, and makes prompt referrals to the relevant parties when needed.
